features.name: servo_gate
features.about: the shutters' servos: GET /api/v1/gate, settings/gate, the screen's Settings, Servo gate

/api/v1.guide: A GET reads and changes nothing. A setting is written with a PATCH of its resource, any of its fields at once, checked whole: if one field is refused, nothing is written. A setting written is live at once, or when its schema's 'applies' says; 'saved' in each settings reply says whether what runs is what is stored, and a POST of {} to the resource's save path stores it. A write may be refused for a moment with 409 busy: the charge's, the scale's and the gate's settings and the powder profile in use while a throw is under way, the motors' while the charge or a purge runs. GET /api/v1/schema describes every field. Weights are in the scale's own unit. The unit runs one job at a time: a charge or a purge. A charge throws the chosen charge profile's target (GET /api/v1/charge_profiles). It is started with POST /api/v1/charge/start once a target is set, and throws until it is stopped: each throw waits for the scale to read zero, pours to the target, gives its verdict, and waits for the cup to be lifted and put back. POST /api/v1/stop stops whatever job runs, and never fails; a job that ended on a fault waits in 'fault' until a stop or a press at the unit. Follow GET /api/v1/events?after=N&wait=30 to see each change, from where you left off. The unit cannot know what is in the cup, nor whether the hopper holds powder: a zero and then a start pours onto whatever is on the pan. Start, and zero, only when a person has said an empty cup is on the pan.

the person's answer at a step: next at cup_on, full at fill, keep at keep, done at empty and failed, go_on at paused. 409 not_now at another step, 409 not_running

while the cup is filled, the coarse tube turned at least these turns from now, back below 0: a turn under way the same way is extended to them, never added to, so it stops within half a turn of the last ask (the knob's detent is a quarter turn, right forward and left back); 409 not_filling at another step

stops the calibration (202), or 200 with nothing to stop; what it found and did not keep is discarded

fields.name: network
fields.about: on the Wi-Fi step, the network chosen, or null

actions.about: the set-up's step as the page goes on (200, GET /api/v1/setup's reply): the unit keeps it, so its screen shows the same stage and a page that lost the hotspot reads where it is; a setup step event. Done is POST /api/v1/setup/done

the set-up finished or skipped (200, {set_up, hotspot}): remembered, so the portal never opens it by itself again (a factory reset forgets it). Joined, the hotspot stops a moment after the reply (hotspot false) and the unit is on its network alone; not joined, the hotspot stays

fields.name: download
fields.about: true: the job fetches the release the poll found itself (found in GET /api/v1/update), checks it and installs it, as the offer's Install at the screen does

actions.about: starts a firmware update (202): the menu takes it and it holds the screen; then PUT the image, unless it downloads. 409 busy also while a person has a screen open at the unit or a poll runs; 409 not_found for a download with nothing found

polls the update's source now (202): GET /api/v1/update's poll and found say what came of it. It also polls once each start, when the station joins. 409 busy while a poll or the update runs; 409 no_network on the unit's own access point

the update image (app.bin of the image GET /api/v1/update takes), application/octet-stream: written into the free slot as it comes, then checked whole (200, ready). 409 not_running unless receiving; 413 too_large; 400 not_an_image, wrong_chip, wrong_board, not_an_update, not_newer, wrong_slot or hash_mismatch, which end the job with nothing installed
restarts into a trial of the image (202); the unit comes back on it, confirmed once on its network, or on the one before. 409 not_ready unless ready
stops the update (202), or 200 with nothing to stop; the image written is never booted
restarts the unit once the reply is out (202)

erases the stored settings and restarts (202): the unit then leaves the network and comes back as its own access point, with a new id and host name. 400 confirm_missing without the confirmation; 409 on_trial while an update runs on trial; 409 no_storage when the settings' EEPROM does not answer

fields.name: ratio
fields.about: 0 open, 1 closed

actions.about: moves the servo gate; 409 gate_disabled when it is off in settings/gate

activity.about: a person has a screen open at the unit that is not a job (the Wi-Fi information, a driver's fault): a start is refused until it is closed there

calibration.about: the empty cup to be put on the scale: answer next
the cup filled a pour at a time (POST pour; the knob at the unit): answer full
the cup to be emptied and put back: answer done
a run would pass the cup's capacity: empty it, put it back, answer go_on
the records found: save, or stop to discard
what failed, in failure: answer done; nothing is retried

update.about: asked, and the menu has not begun it yet
the image is taken into the free slot
all of the image in: its SHA-256, its board and its seal checked
the image is whole and checked: install, or stop
the restart into its trial is under way
ended: the screen is given back, and a start is taken again once it is idle

charge.about: asked, and the menu has not begun it yet
a throw waits for the scale to read zero, steady
a throw pours to the target
the throw's verdict is given: the cup is to be lifted
the cup is away; the next throw begins when it is back
the charge ended on a fault (last.reason) and waits for a stop or a press to acknowledge it

purge.about: asked, and the menu has not begun it yet
ended on a driver's fault, waiting for a stop or a press

driver.about: the driver does not answer on its serial line
the driver restarted and lost its set-up
its motor supply is too low

gate.about: the menu's Disable: the servo is moved no more and stays at its last ratio until charge mode moves it
off in settings/gate: charge mode does not use it

events.about: by: button, api, console
by: button, api, console, or unit when it ended itself; reason: stopped, fault
throw: its number, from 1 at each start of the unit
no reading for 3 of the scale's intervals; pause: its number in the throw
weight: the settled weight it went on from
the verdict; result: good, under, over

a throw cut short; reason: stopped, scale_no_reading, scale_unsteady, scale_unreliable, driver_fault, fault (the fine tube starved of powder, or no memory for the throw); motor and fault only with driver_fault
reason: stopped, time (its time ran out: by the unit), fault
a run would pass the cup's capacity
the records found: GET /api/v1/calibration, result
the records kept and stored
reason: finished, stopped, failed, fault
a driver's fault appeared; motor: coarse, fine; fault: as the driver states
fault: the one that cleared
the unit started; the first event after each start
reason: stopped, refused (with the refusal's code), time
the image is whole and checked
after the restart, the image tried confirmed itself once on its network; reset: the settings it reset to their defaults, by name
after the restart, the image tried was left, and the one before runs; reason: did_not_start, no_network, not_confirmed, power_cut
the poll found a newer release, now offered: GET /api/v1/update, found
a settings resource or a powder written, and what it holds changed: read path again. One for each resource written, never for a write that changed nothing; by: button (the menu), api, console
what was written stored where it was not; path: the save's, so every resource stored by it is saved again
the set-up went on to a step (code, wifi, scale, motors, ready, done): read GET /api/v1/setup; the unit's screen shows the same stage
the set-up's join began: GET /api/v1/network's station names the network
the set-up's join joined: the network stored and in effect, its address in GET /api/v1/network's station
the set-up's join did not join, nothing stored; reason: wrong_password, timeout, failed

throw.name: throw
throw.about: its number, as the throw's events carry it: from 1 at each start

throw.name: at_ms
throw.about: when its verdict was read, or it ended: the unit's clock, as now_ms

throw.name: simulated
throw.about: thrown with the simulated scale: never tune on it

throw.name: result
throw.about: good, under, over; none when it ended short

throw.name: reason
throw.about: finished, or why it ended short: as the throw's ended event

throw.name: weight
throw.about: the verdict's; ended short, the reading at its end

throw.name: elapsed_s
throw.about: the whole pour, from its start after the zero

throw.name: coarse_s
throw.about: from the pour's start to the coarse tube's stop

throw.name: fine_s
throw.about: the fine tube's part: from the coarse tube's stop to the fine stop

throw.name: coarse_stop
throw.about: at the coarse tube's stop: weight, the reading; rps, its speed just before

throw.name: fine_stop
throw.about: at the fine stop: weight, the reading; rps, the fine tube's speed just before

throw.name: fall
throw.about: weight less fine_stop's reading: what landed after the fine stop

throw.name: gains
throw.about: coarse and fine kp, ki, kd it was thrown on; by: profile, or auto_tune (the auto-tuner's trial, in no settings resource)

throw.name: backoff
throw.about: the charge's settings it was thrown on
